_comment: Cost-ledger budget (features/cost-ledger). Raised 2026-11-18: the repo default (200,000 tokens/day, $5/day) blocked the agent — today measured spend was 16,886,675 tokens / $17.07, so the default was 8443% over. Set to 20,000,000 tokens/day and $25/day (headroom above the measured day). Either cap binds: the day stops when EITHER the token cap OR the USD cap is reached. Set a cap to null to disable that cap (not recommended for both at once).
_why_200000: About 2.5x the observed 2026-11-14 day (~73,000 tokens, see features/approvals/README.md). Agentic loops resend full context every turn, so a busy day can reach this honestly — the 80% alert is the warning to raise it, not proof of a runaway. Superseded 2026-11-18: the 2026-11-18 day measured 16,886,675 tokens, so the budget is now 20,000,000 tokens/day and $25/day.
